justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/comparator/CompositeFileComparator.java, src/test/java/org/apache/commons/io/comparator/CompositeFileComparatorTest.java, and src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/comparator/package-info.java. The class is a thin wrapper: it extends AbstractFileComparator, implements Serializable, stores only an array of caller-supplied Comparator<File> delegates, and compare() just iterates those delegates; it has no hard-coded internal dependency graph. Repository references are limited to the test class and package docs, with no production src/main callers, so the fan-in/fan-out evidence is too small for hub-like modularization.
